subfrost_ops_notes: Observer enabled by default in the subfrost-ops fork so Alkanes-stack patterns are captured per-project from day one. Project scoping (via git remote hash) keeps alkanes-rs / subfrost-app / metashrew / subzero-rs / subfrost-mobile instincts isolated. Use /evolve to cluster captured instincts into skills/commands; /promote to lift cross-project patterns to global scope. See docs/patterns/INVENTORY.md section 'Continuous-learning-v2'.
